business: Monthly early-warning model for EXISTING retail customers: P(90+ days past due within the next 6 months) on each month-end (as_of_date); collections contacts the riskiest 10 %.

feature_table.name: balance_trend
feature_table.formula: OLS slope of the 6 month-end balances (INR/month)

feature_table.name: loan_payment_ratio
feature_table.formula: loan payments made / loan payments due (6 months)

feature_table.name: missed_payment_count
feature_table.formula: sum of missed_payment over the last 6 PUBLISHED loan_status months
feature_table.example_input: Jan missed; the March row is published 2023-04-05 and must be ignored on 2023-03-31

feature_table.name: income_stability
feature_table.formula: std / mean of salary amounts (sample std, n-1); NaN if fewer than 2 credits

feature_table.name: account_age
feature_table.formula: whole months from signup_date to as_of

feature_registry.name: average_balance
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: YES - every transaction is posted the day it happens; we only use rows dated on or before as_of_date.

feature_registry.name: balance_trend
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: YES - uses only month-end balances up to as_of_date.

feature_registry.name: salary_credit_frequency
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: YES - credits are posted the day they arrive.

feature_registry.name: loan_payment_ratio
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: YES - a payment is visible in the account the day it is made (earlier than loan_status, which is published 5 days later).

feature_registry.name: missed_payment_count
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: PARTLY - loan_status for month M is published on day 5 of month M+1, so at the month-end of M only months up to M-1 exist. The latest month is NOT used.

feature_registry.name: credit_utilization
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: YES - card purchases are posted the day they happen; credit_limit is a static attribute known at signup.

feature_registry.name: account_age
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: YES - signup_date is known at account opening.

feature_registry.name: util_x_missed
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: YES - computed by add_derived_features() from credit_utilization, missed_payment_count; inherits the availability of its parents.

feature_registry.name: balance_trend_norm
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: YES - computed by add_derived_features() from balance_trend, average_balance; inherits the availability of its parents.

feature_registry.name: log_average_balance
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: YES - computed by add_derived_features() from average_balance; inherits the availability of its parents.

feature_registry.name: average_balance_leaky
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: NO - at scoring time the next 6 months have not happened yet.
feature_registry.rejection_reason: Leakage: includes the post-default balance collapse. Fails the future-perturbation test. Replaced by average_balance v2.

feature_registry.name: dpd_target_period
feature_registry.rejection_reason: Target leakage: default IS 90+ days past due, so this column is the label in disguise.

feature_registry.name: recoveries_target_period
feature_registry.rejection_reason: Target leakage: recoveries exist only AFTER a default has happened.

feature_registry.name: collections_status_latest
feature_registry.prediction_time_availability: NO - known only after the outcome.
feature_registry.rejection_reason: Target leakage: 'in_collections' is set after the default.

feature_registry.name: segment
feature_registry.rejection_reason: Not needed for v1 (behaviour already explains risk) and a possible proxy for occupation/income: requires a fairness review before use.

models.rule: logistic regression is kept unless HistGradientBoosting beats it on VALIDATION by >= 0.005 ROC-AUC

api_latency_ms.note: client-side, 200 sequential POST /predict incl. HTTP, on a shared 2-core Linux VM that was busy with other jobs; an earlier run on an idle VM gave p50 ~17 ms / p95 ~27 ms. Treat as order-of-magnitude.

CORE: prediction timestamp (as_of_date) + availability rule available_at <= as_of_date
feature registry (metadata + lifecycle history) with a Production gate
time-based split with purge gap (never random)
ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, recall@top-10%, lift, KS + business meaning
FastAPI /predict (feature vector in, PD out) + monthly batch scoring
KS drift + data-quality gate + decision ladder with label-lag proxies
champion/challenger retraining with human approval, guardrails and rollback
MLflow, DVC, Docker, Kubernetes/Minikube, Prometheus/Grafana, GitHub Actions CI

failure_scenarios_reproduced: (a) leaky average_balance_leaky in training: test AUC ~0.96, live AUC far lower (04_leakage_demo, 13_failure_scenarios)
(a2) post-default columns (days_past_due / recoveries / collections status of the target period) give AUC 0.94-1.0
(a3) random split vs time split: optimistic AUC
(b) salary_credit_frequency null rate jumps to ~40 % after a source migration -> FIX_DATA_PIPELINE, not retraining (11b, 13)
(c) challenger trained on the stress period only: no gain on the stress hold-out and worse on calm data (13_failure_scenarios)
label lag: labels for the drifted month do not exist for 6 months -> INVESTIGATE, then proxy evidence -> RETRAIN_CANDIDATE (11)
promotion rules fail (ROC-AUC gain below the required bar) even with a human approver name (12)
unpublished loan_status row would inflate missed_payment_count (02_feature_manual_examples)
